description_en: You can call GetFolder to retrieve the details of a folder

parameters.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. Log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID. You must set either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to specify the DataWorks workspace for the API call.
